digest.component_or_area: Jira outbound sync — priority and create_defaults mapping
propositions: Priority mapping must be config-driven via project-keyed priority_map axis, resolving per-project and threading through create and update payloads as optional dict[str,str] parameter.
Unmapped priority values must drift (omit field, warn via reset_drift_warnings sink) rather than fail sync, with no vocabulary validation gating the sync.

String-valued per-project create_defaults axis must be resolved via effective_create_defaults and merged into create payloads for required-beyond-baseline fields, with baseline computed fields winning on collision.

Priority resolution in outbound payloads must use str-keyed baseline map (0→Highest, 1→High, 2→Medium, 3→Low, 4→Lowest) re-declared in config.py without importing value_maps, and consumers look up by str(priority).

Both priority_map and create_defaults must be optional kwargs (defaulting None) on Protocol map_local_to_remote and map_fields_to_remote, maintaining backward compatibility with existing test doubles.
create_defaults applies to create operations only; update operations do not apply or thread create_defaults.
